blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rey Joseph Nieto has been appointed as assistant secretary at the Office of the Cabinet Secretary. His appointment was confirmed by Presidential Communications Office Dave Gomez on Wednesday, September 16. His Appointed letter was dated Sept. 1. Nieto, widely known online as “Thinking Pinoy,” initially gained popularity as a prominent pro-Duterte blogger during the administration of former President Rodrigo Duterte.
